ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central zones on both lobes. Solid black pigmentation forms a central wedge at the peduncle join and continuous thick borders along the trailing and leading edges. Asymmetric black 'bleeding' streaks extend from the trailing edge into the white interior on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation at the center, approximately 55-degree angle with a high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (micro-peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge. Notable large concave indentations (notches) located on the outer distal sections of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe tips show a sharp upward sweep with a convex curve on the posterior boundary transitioning to a concave taper toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular ring-shaped scar on the mid-right lobe. Scattered high-contrast white circular spots (diameter < 1% of lobe width) clustered in the lower central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the interior white surface of the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular scar/ring on the right lobe; significant irregular tissue loss/notching on the distal trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan bio-film staining or pixel-color shift across the majority of the high-intensity ventral white areas.
